scope: Three exact French legal holds only; first-level/autonomous legislative-authority gate. No media/metadata/EPG/rights work.
reason_for_changing_disposition: A hold should identify an unresolved operative instrument, not demand indefinite proof against every hypothetical future delegation. The reviewed ordinary framework requires a separate subject-specific authorization. Guadeloupe’s former mandate has an explicit expiry; the2026paragraph3practice review lists successful use by Guadeloupe/Martinique and names unsuccessful Guyane requests. Current paragraph2adaptation is independently conditional underLO7411-6. Apply default scope with an exact reopening test; do not infer an exhaustive denial of every adaptation grant from that practice report.
consistency_note: Do not exclude merely because rules are delegated, bounded or called regulations. The accepted Czech/Croatian/Japanese/provincial cases have affirmative substantive regional norm-making grants under their ordinary framework. These three records were held specifically for an unproved separate Article73grant; a general route for requesting one is not itself that affirmative grant. This decision does not deny ordinary regulatory, budget or representative powers.

guadeloupe-request.title: Guadeloupe AP/22-19,30June2022; JORF17September2023
guadeloupe-request.finding: The council states the earlier grant expired27June2021. It requests a new parliamentary grant and replaces its November2021request. Publication records a request, not its approval.

an-2026.title: National Assembly report2905,10June2026
an-2026.provisions: Introduction, Article73practice; commentary on energy habilitation
an-2026.finding: For Article73paragraph3 habilitation-fixation, the report identifies successful use by Guadeloupe and Martinique. It says Guadeloupe’s2022energy request and three specifically named Guyane requests had no legislative follow-through. It does not exhaustively deny every paragraph2adaptation or every later enactment.

regional-framework.title: CGCT, overseas regions, current2026structure
regional-framework.finding: A specific law or Conseil-d’État decree grants the habilitation according to the subject. The enabling procedure and possible one-time extension do not themselves supply a fresh grant.

common-adaptation.title: CGCT LO7411-1, effective1January2026
common-adaptation.finding: Guyane, Martinique and Mayotte can be authorized to adapt laws/regulations. The wording establishes eligibility to seek authorization, not an automatic authorization.

common-grant.title: CGCT LO7411-6, effective1January2026
common-grant.finding: A law grants legislative adaptation; a Conseil-d’État decree grants regulatory-only adaptation. The grant is time-limited to assembly renewal.

common-rule-setting.title: CGCT LO7412-1, effective1January2026
common-rule-setting.finding: The three assemblies may receive bounded rule-setting grants under Article73; this is a conditional framework, distinct from an enacted body-specific grant.

mayotte-reorganization.title: Organic Law2025-793 of11August2025,Article1
mayotte-reorganization.finding: Mayotte’s reorganization relocates and extends the common habilitation procedure. Preserve the2026Department-Region/Assembly identity; renumbering does not prove a subject-specific lawmaking grant.

mayotte-government-ordinance.title: Ordinance2026-647 of22July2026
mayotte-government-ordinance.finding: Social-security adaptation is by the national Government under constitutionalArticle38. It is not an Article73grant to the Mayotte Assembly.

martinique-actual-grant.title: Law2026-574 of30June2026,JORF1July2026
martinique-actual-grant.finding: The new energy/water/sanitation grant names the Martinique Assembly. It does not authorize Guadeloupe, Guyane or Mayotte merely because their enabling framework is shared.

ordinary-region.title: CGCT ordinary regional competences
ordinary-region.finding: Regional deliberation operates within attributed competences; the council approves its budget and makes regional plans/proposals. Those real regulatory, planning and financial powers are acknowledged, rather than denied.

ordinary-guyane.title: CGCT ordinary Guyane competences
ordinary-guyane.finding: The Assembly governs territorial affairs and development within a combined departmental/regional framework, with its own budget. This is affirmative evidence of representative/administrative powers; authority clearance under the project rule still needs substantive autonomous normative powers beyond that proved framework.

ordinary-mayotte.title: CGCT L7311-1, effective1January2026
ordinary-mayotte.finding: Mayotte exercises the competences assigned by law to departments and overseas regions. The combined framework has real regulation/budget functions; Article73subject-specific authorization is a separate legal mechanism.

records.name: Conseil régional Guadeloupe
records.decision_basis: Close the current-scope hold as outside_default_scope on the evidenced ordinary regional framework and expired special grant. Preserve its real historical territorial legislation. A possible future renewal is a reopening event, not an unknown institution that must remain indefinitely unclassified.
records.decision_character: Project default-scope classification of the proved framework; not a judicial finding, a complete legislative-consolidation certificate or proof that no later grant could exist.
reopening_evidence: A body-specific enacted/operative Article73grant or another substantive autonomous territorial legislative allocation, with subjects, commencement, expiry/renewal and the assembly authorized.
Do not reopen merely on the generic enabling procedure, a pending request, continued applicability of old measures, a national-governmentArticle38ordinance, or a renamed territorial authority.
records.currentness_limit: National Assembly negative practice review is dated10June2026; targeted searches through24October2026located no later operative grant for this assembly. Search silence is not treated as universal proof of non-enactment. Classification rests on the positively evidenced ordinary/conditional framework, with the exact reopening test retained.
confirmed_findings: The council is a real first-level regional authority with ordinary regulatory, planning and budget powers.
Its published AP/22-19 renewal request explicitly dates expiry of the former energy grant to27June2021.
AN2905,10June2026records that request without legislative follow-through; the2026grant inspected names Martinique.
